batch._notes: Concurrent multi-session engine (bin/wzy_batch_engine). enabled=false keeps the 256K + MTP single-stream path. When enabled: N resident sessions decode on private streams, cold experts are shared, promotion is deferred per round, and multi-turn prefix reuse is by full-prefix match (no park/restore). Trade-offs: no MTP/speculation and ctx is capped at the VRAM KV ring (32768) because this engine has no host KV mirror. slots is clamped by free VRAM at boot.

_env_notes: WZY_TYP_RANK / WZY_TYP_MARGIN / WZY_TYP_MAX_SLACK = speculative acceptance knobs. MARGIN IS IN RAW LOGIT UNITS (temperature is NOT divided out), so real strictness = margin / T; at T=0.3 margin=1.8 means a 1/400 probability ratio, i.e. the feature is effectively off. Production default is RANK=1 (exact, lossless): measurements show every non-argmax acceptance can push code generation into repetition (boilerplate task: 0.000% -> 53.700% duplicate 20-gram). MAX_SLACK caps non-argmax acceptances per window and cuts that to 3.2%, but never back to baseline, and once tightened enough the speed matches RANK=1. Kept for experiments only. LoopGuard (serve/server.py, on by default) stops a degenerate turn after ~48 tokens of repetition: config.json top-level loop_guard {gram,repeats,window} or WZY_LOOP_* env; WZY_LOOP_GUARD=0 disables. Only affects temperature > 0 traffic -- temp=0 takes the fast_greedy GPU-argmax path and never reaches the verification function. See README section 4.
